posts.text: When Pope JP II was in his final months, he did not hide the process of his failing earthly body, but shared it. He was shedding this world and going to the Father. Ben Sasse, is giving us that gift now. Pay attention. Lessons from his daughter Alex here.  thefp.com/p/ben-sasse-parent…
